description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hindagada, Kandy four Gravets & Gangawata Korale D/S/Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No.320293 (24/0139)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, ownership details, and land extent measurements. The content focuses on land ownership adjudication and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
